    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Flutter3.41+Dart3.11+Get实战仿携程/去哪儿旅行酒店预订app应用模板</span>

            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><span style="font-size: 18px; font-family: 宋体, &quot;Songti SC&quot;; color: rgba(255, 102, 0, 1)">2026爆肝研发<span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 153, 1)">flutter3.41.5+getx</span>跨平台仿携程/飞猪app旅游酒店预约系统。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 12px"><strong>flutter3-hotel</strong>：基于<span style="background-color: rgba(204, 255, 204, 1)">flutter3.41+dart3.11+get+cached_network_image</span>搭建跨平台旅行app酒店预订助手。集成了<strong><span style="background-color: rgba(204, 255, 255, 1)">酒店首页、酒店预订/搜索/列表/详情、探索、订单、聊天消息、我的</span></strong>等功能模块。</span></p>
<p><img alt="未标题-13" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202604/1289798-20260421155453868-131630838.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="p1" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202604/1289798-20260421155531370-2076452740.gif" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3>使用技术</h3>
<ul>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">编辑器：vscode</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">技术框架：flutter3.41.5+dart3.11.3</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">路由/状态管理：get^4.7.3</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">本地缓存：get_storage^2.1.1</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">图片轮播组件：card_swiper^3.0.1</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">图片缓存：cached_network_image^3.4.1</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">日期选择插件：syncfusion_flutter_datepicker^33.1.49</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">弹层提示：shirne_dialog^4.9.0</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">瀑布流组件：flutter_staggered_grid_view^0.7.0</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">滚动定位组件：scrollable_positioned_list^0.3.8</span></li>
</ul>

<p><span style="font-size: 12px">使用最新跨平台框架Flutter3.41初始创建项目模板。</span></p>

<pre>import 'dart:io'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

import </span>'utils/common.dart'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 引入布局页面</span>

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 引入路由配置</span>
import 'router/index.dart'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> main() async {
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 初始化get_storage存储</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  await GetStorage.init();
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 初始化国际化语言</span>
  initializeDateFormatting('zh_CN'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
  
  runApp(const MyApp());
}

class MyApp extends StatelessWidget {
  const MyApp({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AnnotatedRegion(
      value: SystemUiOverlayStyle(

         * The bottom navigation bar is always black from flutter: 3.32.1.
         * It's working fine on flutter: 3.29.3
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        systemNavigationBarColor: Colors.transparent,
        systemNavigationBarIconBrightness: Brightness.dark,
      ),
      child: GetMaterialApp(
        title: </span>'Flutter3 Trip'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,

        theme: ThemeData(
          colorScheme: ColorScheme.fromSeed(seedColor: Color(</span>0xffffaa00<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)),

        home: const Layout(),

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 路由页面</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        getPages: routePages,

      ),

}</span></pre>

<h3>通用布局模板</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>import 'package:flutter/material.dart'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
import </span>'package:flutter_svg/flutter_svg.dart'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 引入pages页面</span>
import '../pages/index/index.dart'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
import </span>'../pages/hotel/index.dart'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
import </span>'../pages/message/index.dart'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
import </span>'../pages/explore/index.dart'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
import </span>'../pages/my/index.dart'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

class Layout extends StatefulWidget {
  const Layout({super.key});

  @override
  State</span>&lt;Layout&gt; createState() =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _LayoutState();
}

class _LayoutState extends State</span>&lt;Layout&gt; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">with</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AutomaticKeepAliveClientMixin {
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> page索引</span>
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> pageCurrent = 0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> page页面</span>
  late final List&lt;Widget&gt; pageList =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> const [
    IndexPage(),
    HotelPage(),
    ExplorePage(),
    Message(),
    MyPage()
  ];

  @override
  bool get wantKeepAlive </span>=&gt; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 动态生成导航项</span>
  List&lt;BottomNavigationBarItem&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> buildNavItems() {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> [
      BottomNavigationBarItem(
        ...
      ),
      BottomNavigationBarItem(
        ...
      ),
      BottomNavigationBarItem(
        ...
      ),
      BottomNavigationBarItem(
        ...
      ),
      BottomNavigationBarItem(
        ...
      ),
    ];
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    super.build(context);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: Colors.grey[</span>50<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">],
      body: IndexedStack(
        index: pageCurrent,
        children: pageList,
      ),
      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 底部导航栏</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">      bottomNavigationBar: Theme(
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Flutter去掉BottomNavigationBar底部导航栏的水波纹</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        data: ThemeData(
          splashColor: Colors.transparent,
          highlightColor: Colors.transparent,
          hoverColor: Colors.transparent,
        ),
        child: Stack(
          children: [
            Container(
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                border: Border(top: BorderSide(color: Colors.black45, width: .</span>1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)),
              ),
              child: BottomNavigationBar(
                backgroundColor: Colors.white,
                fixedColor: Color(</span>0xffffaa00<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
                unselectedItemColor: Colors.black,
                type: BottomNavigationBarType.fixed,

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            Positioned(
              left: MediaQuery.of(context).size.width </span>/ 2 - 18<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,

<h3>flutter3自定义滚动槽</h3>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202604/1289798-20260421162251913-1163693144.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>late ScrollController indicatorController =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ScrollController();

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 记录滚动位置</span>
final ValueNotifier&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">double</span>&gt; indicatorOffset = ValueNotifier(0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

@override
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> initState() {
  super.initState();

  indicatorController.addListener(() {
    indicatorOffset.value </span>= indicatorController.position.pixels /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> indicatorController.position.maxScrollExtent;
  });
}

Column(
  children: [
    Expanded(
      child: SingleChildScrollView(
        controller: indicatorController,
        scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
        padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: </span>12.0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
        child: Row(
          ...
        ),
      ),
    ),
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 指示槽</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    ValueListenableBuilder(
      valueListenable: indicatorOffset,
      builder: (context, offset, child) {
        final indicatorWidth </span>= 20.0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        final trackWidth </span>= 50.0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 可移动的最大距离</span>
        final maxTranslate = trackWidth -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> indicatorWidth;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 根据滚动进度计算位移</span>
        final translateX = maxTranslate * offset.clamp(0.0, 1.0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Stack(
          children: [
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 轨道</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            Container(
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: Color(</span>0xffffaa00).withAlpha(50<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(</span>50.0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
              ),
              height: </span>4.0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
              width: trackWidth,
            ),
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 滑块</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            Transform.translate(
              offset: Offset(translateX, </span>0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
              child: Container(
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: Color(</span>0xffffaa00<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(</span>50.0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
                ),
                height: </span>4.0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                width: indicatorWidth,
              ),
            ),
          ],
        );
      },
    ),
  ],
),</span></pre>

<h3>flutter3酒店预订模块</h3>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202604/1289798-20260421163307836-646738926.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>预订模块单独封装成了一个组件。</p>
<p><img alt="18baf9653d70e50233897c9b67e26c8c_1289798-20250220115808387-1498483440" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202604/1289798-20260421163354050-106175230.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>热门城市、位置品牌选择</strong></li>
</ul>
<p><span style="font-size: 12px">使用&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">scrollable_positioned_list</span>&nbsp;组件实现滑动字母索引滚动到指定列表位置。</span></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202604/1289798-20260421164341590-2013692768.png" class="lazyload">&nbsp;&nbsp;<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202604/1289798-20260421163658102-809272540.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>ItemScrollController itemScrollController =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ItemScrollController();

ScrollablePositionedList.builder(
  itemScrollController: itemScrollController,
  itemCount: citylist.length,
  itemBuilder: (context, index) {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ...</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  }
)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 侧边索引</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Align(
  alignment: Alignment.centerRight,
  child: GestureDetector(
    child: Container(
      color: Colors.transparent,
      width: </span>25.0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
      child: Column(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
        children: List.generate(pinyinList.length, (index) {
          </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> GestureDetector(
            child: Container(
              ...
            ),
            onTapDown: (details) {
              </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 跳转指定索引位置</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">              itemScrollController.jumpTo(index: index);
              setState(() {
                selectedLetter </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> pinyinList[index];
                showBubble </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
              });
              Future.delayed(Duration(milliseconds: </span>200<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">), () {
                setState(() {
                  selectedLetter </span>= ''<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                  showBubble </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                });
              });
            },
          );
        }),
      ),
    ),
    onVerticalDragUpdate: (details) {
      updateSelectedLetter(details.localPosition);
    },
    onVerticalDragEnd: (details) {
      setState(() {
        selectedLetter </span>= ''<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        showBubble </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
      });
    },
  ),
),</span></pre>
</div>
<ul>
<li><strong>入住/离店日期选择</strong></li>
</ul>
<p><span style="font-size: 12px">使用&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">syncfusion_flutter_datepicker</span>&nbsp;插件选择入住/离店日期。</span></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202604/1289798-20260421163811514-818894623.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 入住日期</span>
DateTime startDate =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> DateTime.now();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 离店日期</span>
DateTime endDate = DateTime.now().add(Duration(days: 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));

GestureDetector(
  child: Container(
    padding: EdgeInsets.all(</span>10.0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
    decoration: BoxDecoration(
      border: Border(bottom: BorderSide(color: Color(</span>0xfff5f5f5<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">))),
    ),
    child: Row(
      spacing: </span>10.0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
      children: [
        Icon(Icons.calendar_month_outlined),
        Expanded(
          child: Row(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
            children: [
              Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                spacing: </span>3.0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                children: [
                  Text(</span>'入住', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.grey, fontSize: 12.0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)),
                  Text(</span>'${DateFormat('MM-dd').format(startDate)} ${DateFormat('E', 'zh_CN').format(startDate)}'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
                ],
              ),
              Container(
                color: Colors.grey[</span>50<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">],
                padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: </span>5.0, vertical: 1.0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> DateTime 类提供了 difference 方法，可以计算两个日期之间的时间差，返回一个 Duration 对象。通过 Duration 的 inDays 属性，可以获取天数差。</span>
                child: Text('共${endDate.difference(startDate).inDays}晚'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
              ),
              Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.end,
                spacing: </span>3.0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                children: [
                  Text(</span>'离店', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.grey, fontSize: 12.0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)),
                  Text(</span>'${DateFormat('MM-dd').format(endDate)} ${DateFormat('E', 'zh_CN').format(endDate)}'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
                ],
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
        Icon(Icons.arrow_forward_ios_rounded, color: Colors.grey, size: </span>12.0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,)
      ],
    ),
  ),
  onTap: () {
    handleCalendar();
  },
)</span></pre>

<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> handleCalendar() {

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">              initialSelectedRange: PickerDateRange(startDate, endDate),

              backgroundColor: Colors.white,

              </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 选中颜色</span>
              selectionColor: Color(0xFF006ff6<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),

              monthViewSettings: DateRangePickerMonthViewSettings(

                  textStyle: TextStyle(color: Color(</span>0xFF130438), fontSize: 12, fontFamily: 'Arial'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
                ),
                dayFormat: </span>'EE'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,

                backgroundColor: Colors.white,

                  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> color: Color(0xFFf7f4ff),</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                ),
                todayTextStyle: TextStyle(color: Color(</span>0xFF006ff6<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)),

<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202604/1289798-20260421164802895-751153955.png" class="lazyload">&nbsp;&nbsp;<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202604/1289798-20260421164819642-259079649.png" class="lazyload"></p>

<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 筛选下拉框</span>

Positioned(
  top: dropdownOffset,
  height: MediaQuery.of(context).size.height </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> dropdownOffset,

  child: ScrollConfiguration(
    behavior: CustomScrollBehavior(),
    child: Material(
      color: Colors.transparent,
      child: Column(
        children: [
          SizeTransition(
            sizeFactor: animation, </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 高度展开动画</span>
            axis: Axis.vertical, <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 垂直方向展开</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            child: Container(
              color: Colors.white,
              width: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">double</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.infinity,
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(dropdownIndex == 0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                  dropOption1(),
                  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(dropdownIndex == 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                  dropOption2(),
                  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(dropdownIndex == 2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                  dropOption3(),
                  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(dropdownIndex == 3<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                  dropOption4(),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
          Expanded(
            child: FadeTransition(
              opacity: animation,
              child: GestureDetector(
                child: Container(
                  color: Colors.black54,
                ),
                onTap: () {
                  setState(() {
                    closeDropdown();
                  });
                },
              ),
            ),

        ],
      ),
    ),
  ),
